title: Legenda internal
disclaimer: Bukan standar resmi Kemenkes/PDGI. Komponen dapat diganti saat formulir resmi tersedia.

surfaces.L: Lingual (rahang bawah) / palatal (rahang atas). Id dan data-surface selalu L.
surfaces.visibleLabel: P on upper teeth (palatal), L on lower teeth (lingual). P is never used in ids or data-surface.

chart.look: Chart-level dentition mix. The full chart uses mixed.

tooth.look: Ghosted tooth; first-visit presence flag, distinct from condition hilang.
tooth.dentition: data-dentition="permanent|primary" already exists on each tooth.

draft.look: Dashed violet outline, light violet wash, diamond mark

signed.look: Solid thicker outline plus lock glyph

layering.note: 3D view (3d-blender/). One tooth record holds an ordered list of layers; later layers paint on top.
layering.layer: {condition, surfaces?: [M|D|O|I|B|L], status}. No surfaces = whole tooth.
layering.planned: direncanakan = hatched tint + dashed glyph/outline; selesai / sudah_ada = solid.
layering.hides: hilang hides every other layer (empty dashed slot + X). sisa_akar swaps to the roots-only render. implan swaps to the implant render.
layering.supernumerary: Optional small slot next to a tooth: data-tooth="S12" (half size).

statuses.note: Kemungkinan MVP, menunggu persetujuan Jerome. Independent of condition colour+shape.

items.label: Kondisi
items.visual: Default watch mark: small solid disk in the corner, full opacity.

items.label: Sudah ada (di sini)
items.visual: Small filled square marker, full opacity, solid outline.

items.label: Sudah ada (di tempat lain)
items.visual: Small open square marker, slightly reduced opacity.

items.label: Direncanakan
items.visual: Small triangle marker, reduced opacity, dashed outline.

items.label: Selesai
items.visual: Small check marker, full opacity, solid outline.

items.label: Dirujuk
items.visual: Small arrow marker, slightly reduced opacity, dotted outline.
